specs.title: Vulnerability Advisor for IBM Cloud Container Registry

images_per_repo.description: Determines how many images are retained in each repository when the retention policy is processed. The default value -1 denotes 'Unlimited' (all images are retained). Additional images might be retained in each repository if the retention setting 'deletion_threshold_days' is used.

namespace.description: The namespace to which the retention policy is attached.

retain_untagged.description: Determines whether untagged images are retained when the retention policy is processed. The value is false by default, which means that untagged images can be deleted when the policy runs.
